title: MarketPay
tagline: A Stripe-like API for crypto payments, subscriptions, and automated settlement.
description:
This project is a SaaS platform that enables businesses to seamlessly accept, manage, and automate crypto payments without requiring deep blockchain expertise. It provides a unified API and dashboard to handle one-time payments for product sales in a simple and scalable way.

MarketPay allows merchants to easily add crypto as an additional payment option, expanding their payment capabilities. The platform is designed to integrate smoothly into existing marketplaces and applications, enabling fast and frictionless crypto transactions.

To get started, companies register on the platform and create their products through a dedicated dApp. When a customer initiates a payment, they are redirected to a secure checkout page where they can complete the transaction using their own wallet.

The goal of this product is to fully abstract and delegate payment logic to a dedicated provider, removing the complexity of blockchain interactions from both merchants and end users, and delivering a seamless payment experience comparable to traditional solutions like Stripe.
how_its_made:
We use Next.js for the frontend and Supabase for the database. For wallet connectivity, we rely on ReOwn, which enables authentication via email or social login.

A company that wants to use our product simply needs to log in, create a new product, and generate a corresponding payment link. This link can then be integrated into their platform for the associated product.

Finally, the company sets up a webhook to receive payment notifications. With this system, the platform no longer needs to handle any crypto-related logic, as everything is fully delegated to our service.
auto_summary: A Next.js SaaS dApp lets merchants create products and crypto payment links, with checkout, authentication, and webhook-based payment notifications.
